decisions.reason: As a large established German machinery firm, we are likely to keep this recently launched printer because it probably required substantial development investment, is already publicly presented, and there is no clear evidence yet that weak early outcomes are more than temporary start-up effects.

We would still keep this software module because it was explicitly announced as an expansion of our portfolio, creating public and strategic commitment, even though its somewhat lower asset specificity makes discontinuation slightly easier than for the hardware products.

We are likely to continue this coder since it fits the firm's industrial marking business, likely embodies meaningful sunk engineering and market-launch costs, and management can plausibly attribute any early challenges to normal market-entry adjustment rather than failure.
